p43-47: Each column prints a 'VOTOS OBJETADOS' row that has no label in this format and is included in TOTAL GENERAL. It is folded into `nulos` here so valid + nulos + blancos = total: Iquique printed nulos 441 + objetados 15 = 456; Departamento Iquique 504 + 15 = 519; Total Provincia Tarapacá 1.112 + 15 = 1.127; Antofagasta 859 + 1 = 860; Departamento Antofagasta 956 + 1 = 957. Every other column on these pages prints a dash for objetados. The reference's grouping nulos (2.841) excludes the 16 objetados, so units' nulos will add to 16 more than it.
